abstract: Recent advances in intensive care procedures have improved the therapeutic results of choriocarcinoma treatment. The mortality of patients with choriocarcinoma, which was 100% in 1958, has gradually decreased, and finally fell to about 10% in 1983. These favorable results have been mainly due to the progress made in chemotherapy, including combined administration of methotrexate and actinomycin-D. However, recent progress has been chiefly dependent on intensive care procedures, involving so-called multidisciplinary treatment, including surgical treatment for pulmonary or intracranial metastatic foci and whole-brain irradiation. When the treatment results for choriocarcinoma were compared between metastatic and non-metastatic cases, the mortality, which had decreased for both groups with time, had already reached 0% in non-metastatic cases, although it was still about 20% in metastatic cases. These results have made it clear that the most important aspect is how to treat choriocarcinoma metastatic foci. With the goal of finding some form of treatment that will help to attain complete cure of choriocarcinoma, we present here details of recent progress made in choriocarcinoma treatment.
abstract_ja: 集中治療の進歩により、絨毛癌の治療成績は改善している。1958年には死亡率100%であった絨毛癌患者の死亡率は徐々に低下し、1983年にはおよそ10%まで下がった。この良好な成績は主にメトトレキサートとアクチノマイシンDの併用投与を含む化学療法の進歩によるものである。しかし近年の進歩は主として、肺または頭蓋内転移巣に対する外科治療や全脳照射を含む、いわゆる集学的治療を含む集中治療によるものである。絨毛癌を転移の有無で比較すると、両群ともに経時的に死亡率は低下し、非転移例では既に0%に達したが、転移例ではなお約20%であった。これらの結果から、絨毛癌の転移巣をどう治療するかが最も重要であることが明らかになった。絨毛癌の完全治癒をもたらす治療法の確立を目指し、本稿では絨毛癌治療の最近の進歩の詳細を提示する。
